hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Europe, between the Adriatic Sea and Serbia || highly indented coastline with narrow coastal plain backed by rugged high limestone mountains and plateaus || strategic location along the Adriatic coast || Resources: bauxite, hydroelectricity || Exports: electricity, aluminum, copper ore, aluminum ore, packaged medicine (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: highly indented coastline with narrow coastal plain backed by rugged high limestone mountains and plateaus || Southeastern Europe, between the Adriatic Sea and Serbia

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean climate, hot dry summers and autumns and relatively cold winters with heavy snowfalls inland || destructive earthquakes

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income, small Balkan economy; uses euro as de facto currency; reduced growth due to slowdown in tourism and industrial production; new impetus for EU accession under Europe Now government; energy price cap and declining food and services prices easing inflation rate || Exports: electricity, aluminum, copper ore, aluminum ore, packaged medicine (2023) || Industries: steelmaking, aluminum, agricultural processing, consumer goods, tourism
